    FAQs for your travel eSIMs

    Frequently Asked Questions

    What is an eSIM?

    An eSIM (embedded SIM) is a digital SIM card that can be installed directly into your smartphone or other mobile devices. It is an alternative to the physical SIM card you’re used to. If you’re wondering for further information on “What is an eSIM?” and its advantages, read more to discover how it can benefit you.

    When will I receive my eSIM?

    When you buy an eSIM for United Kingdom from Holafly, you’ll receive it by email immediately after your purchase. You can buy your United Kingdom eSIM online before your trip, install it in advance, and activate it once you arrive.

    There’s no need to visit a store or wait for a physical SIM card to be delivered — everything is handled online.

    Which devices work with the eSIM card for United Kingdom?

    All smartphones with eSIM technology enabled are compatible, including recent iPhone, Samsung Galaxy and Google Pixel models. If your phone has an eSIM slot you can install the United Kingdom eSIM alongside your existing SIM. Not sure if your device is compatible? Check compatibility.

    What is the best eSIM for United Kingdom?

    Holafly offers the best eSIM for United Kingdom, with unlimited data, instant delivery, and easy activation. Whether you’re traveling for work or vacation, our eSIM ensures fast and reliable connectivity in United Kingdom without roaming fees.

    What is Always On?

    A 1 GB monthly benefit included with every Holafly eSIM. It becomes available once you install the eSIM and is valid in 150+ countries. To keep enjoying Always On, simply keep your eSIM installed and don’t delete it.

    Your 1 GB allowance refreshes every 30 days and data doesn’t accumulate - it resets to 1 GB at the start of each cycle.

    More details about Always On

    Do I need to delete the Holafly eSIM once I've finished my plan?

    No, you don’t need to do so. As soon as your plan expires, your eSIM will no longer work.

    Can I use my physical SIM card and Holafly United Kingdom eSIM at the same time?

    If you are using a dual SIM phone or an Apple device, you can use your physical SIM card and your eSIM in the same device. Choose the SIM card for phone calls and SMS, and Holafly eSIM for data from your device. Please remember that if you leave your SIM card activated, your mobile data network provider may apply data roaming charges to receive or make phone calls as well as SMS.

    You can also use your Holafly eSIM and your existing eSIM while traveling in United Kingdom.

    How do I install and activate an eSIM for United Kingdom on my phone?

    After your purchase you will be sent a QR code and manual instructions to your email to help you setup your eSIM for United Kingdom on your device. Either print the QR code or open it on your computer. On your cellphone go to: Settings > Mobile data > Add data plan and scan the QR code (or enter the code manually). Your cellphone will allow you to assign a specific name to this data plan. You will now be able to switch between your Holafly data plan and the original plan from your provider. The Holafly data plan will only be operational once you arrive at your destination. Once you land, turn on data roaming on your cellphone settings and activate the Holafly data plan. Consult your phone’s user manual for more details on adding a data plan. All eSIM products come with comprehensive set-up instructions.

    How do I get a refund?

    At Holafly we are aware that our users may have unforeseen events after making the purchase. Therefore, you can request a refund in the following circumstances:

    • You bought the eSIM without checking the compatibility with your cellphone.
    • You canceled your trip or you no longer need the eSIM.
    • Our eSIMs generally work fine, but if you experience connection issues, we can provide you with a full or partial refund.

    Once the refund is approved, you will receive the money on to the same account with which you made the payment. This process can take between 3 to 5 business days.

    For more details, terms and conditions, we invite you to read our Refund Policy.

    What is the most affordable eSIM for the UK?

    The cheapest eSIM for the UK is Holafly’s, offering the best value for money: for 3.9 USD you get unlimited data, ensuring a reliable connection throughout your trip to the United Kingdom. Plus, with the Always On benefit, you’ll receive 1 GB every month in 150+ countries, with no expiration date or additional charges.

    When does my data plan begin?

    Your plan activates immediately upon connecting your eSIM to any supported network. For example, if you bought a 1-day plan and you activate your plan at 10 AM, it remains active for a full 24 hours, concluding at 10 AM the following day.

    Can I make phone calls and send messages with my Holafly eSIM?

    The United Kingdom digital eSIM only comes with cellular data. It does not include a local phone number for traditional phone calls or text messages, so it is not a United Kingdom eSIM with a phone number. However, you can still use your eSIM in United Kingdom for unlimited internet data and make international calls or send messages through internet-based apps and VoIP services such as WhatsApp.

    How many times can I use my eSIM card?

    Your eSIM for international travel can’t be transferred or reinstalled once it’s installed. If you switch phones or accidentally delete it during your trip, you’ll just need to get a new one. Our support team is always around if you need help!

    What happens if I use up my data or my days of validity?

    If you use all your data or run out of days, your eSIM card will no longer work and you will lose internet connection.

    Do I have to activate data roaming on my device?

    Yes. To ensure that your eSIM gets the best coverage, you must turn on data roaming on your phone’s settings. This will not incur any additional charges, as long as you have already the Holafly eSIM set up correctly.

    When should I set up my eSIM?

    Set up your eSIM before your departure. Once you reach United Kingdom, simply activate your data plan by turning on data roaming. With instant eSIM activation United Kingdom, you can get connected quickly as soon as your eSIM connects to a supported local network.

    We recommend printing the QR code and taking it with you on vacation, just in case. Remember that you need internet access to install the eSIM.

    How can I purchase an eSIM for the UK from Australia?

    For Aussie travellers exploring the UK, Holafly is especially useful if you use a lot of mobile data. If you’re looking for the best eSIM for the UK from Australia, Holafly offers unlimited data, so you don’t need to worry about running out of data or constantly topping up.

    There’s no need to visit a store or buy a physical SIM when you arrive. Just install it before your trip and you’re ready to go. Once you arrive in the UK, simply activate the eSIM, connect to a supported local network, and start using your data.

    What United Kingdom eSIM data plan should I choose?

    If you’re planning a trip to United Kingdom and want to enjoy a fast and reliable connection throughout your journey, you will definitely need an eSIM United Kingdom with Unlimited Data. You can choose a plan that suits your trip, from 1 to 90 days.

    Select the number of eSIMs you need for your fellow travellers, install them before you leave, and activate them as soon as you arrive.

    Can I keep my WhatsApp number?

    You don’t need to do anything to keep your WhatsApp number. You’ll automatically keep your number, contacts and conversations.

    How quick is the Holafly eSIM?

    Your Holafly virtual eSIM for United Kingdom can connect to fast 5G networks where available, so you can enjoy the benefits of a 5G eSIM in United Kingdom, as well as 4G and LTE coverage. Actual speeds may vary depending on your location, device and local network coverage.

    Can I share Data with other devices?

    Stay connected and share your eSIM data with family, friends, or fellow travelers. Simply turn your smartphone into a Wi-Fi hotspot and connect multiple devices, with 1 GB of shareable data available per day so you can use your eSIM for multiple devices in United Kingdom.

    The total amount of data you can share depends on the eSIM plan duration you chose. For example, a 7-day plan includes up to 7 GB of shareable data.

    Can I use my Holafly eSIM in my home country?

    Holafly eSIMs are specially designed to keep you connected while traveling abroad. For this reason, they don’t provide connectivity for domestic use within your home country (including the entire EU region if you are an EU-based resident).

    Can I transfer my eSIM for the UK to an eSIM in Europe once it has been installed?

    No, a UK eSIM that has already been installed and activated cannot be transferred to an eSIM for Europe with Unlimited Data or to another destination. If your travel plans are not fully set and you may visit several countries in Europe in addition to the UK, the eSIM for Europe is a more suitable option, as it lets you stay connected across multiple destinations with a single plan.

    Can I use a UK eSIM in Ireland?

    No, the Holafly UK eSIM only provides coverage in England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland, but not throughout all of Ireland. If you’re visiting both the UK and Ireland, you can choose Holafly’s Europe eSIM, which offers unlimited data across both destinations and other European countries without needing to switch eSIMs. This way, you can stay connected throughout your trip without worrying about running out of data.

    Could the internet speed with my Holafly eSIM be reduced?

    In rare cases, yes. Network operators use an international measure called the Fair Usage Policy. This is temporarily applied for no more than one (1) day to manage network traffic, ensuring an optimal connection for all users. While this is external to Holafly, there’s no need to worry! If your speed is reduced, the restriction will reset the following day, restoring your plan’s original speed.

    What is the best eSIM app for United Kingdom?

    Thanks to its unlimited data plans, good coverage across many destinations, easy installation, and 24/7 customer service, Holafly is the best eSIM app for international travel. You can install your eSIM before departure and activate it when you arrive, making it simple to stay connected without worrying about running out of data.

    You’ll also benefit from Always On, which gives you 1GB of backup data every month in over 150 countries, with no expiration date or additional charges.

    What do I do if I delete or lose my eSIM’s QR code?

    Don’t worry, you can always see the details of your eSIM in the Holafly App. Download the app from your app store and log in with the email you used for your purchase. There, you will find all the available settings to install the eSIM. Also, you can contact our 24/7 support team via WhatsApp or online live chat for immediate assistance.

    If you have any questions during this process, remember we're here to assist you 24/7 through our Online chat.
